questions.question: What is the newly discovered form of hydrogen found in the Moselle region of France?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**White Hydrogen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Europe Hits Jackpot Worth $92 Trillion, Uncovers World's Largest White Hydrogen Deposit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **White hydrogen** is a **naturally occurring gas** found in the Earth's crust with no need for industrial production.
 
• It emits **zero carbon**, making it an environmentally superior energy source.
 
• **White hydrogen** is valued at **$92 trillion** in the Moselle region of France, with a reserve of **46 million tons**.
 
• **Green hydrogen** is produced using **renewable energy** sources like **wind**, **solar**, and **hydropower** through **electrolysis** (splitting water into hydrogen and oxygen).
 
• **Gray hydrogen** is produced from **natural gas** using **steam methane reforming (SMR)**, which releases **CO2** and contributes to **greenhouse gas emissions**.
 
• **Blue hydrogen** is similar to gray hydrogen, but it involves **capturing and storing CO2 emissions** to reduce environmental impact.
 
• **White hydrogen** is different from other forms because it requires **no industrial production** and produces no carbon emissions.

questions.question: The recent government data shows over 30.68 crore unorganised workers have registered on the e-Shram portal, with women making up 53.68% of the total. In which year was the e-Shram portal launched?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2021.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The e-Shram portal was launched in 2021 to create a comprehensive National Database of Unorganised Workers (NDUW).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The portal aims to provide unorganised workers with access to social security benefits through a Universal Account Number (UAN).**
 
• **Women account for 53.68% of the total 30.68 crore workers registered on the portal.**
 
• **The portal integrates multiple welfare schemes for ease of access to workers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• e-Shram__

 __
 
• The government launched the e-Shram portal on August 26, 2021, with the objective of creating a comprehensive National Database of Unorganised Workers (NDUW), seeded with Aadhaar.
 
• The portal provides registered workers with a Universal Account Number (UAN) on a self-declaration basis, enabling them to access various social security schemes.
 
• Expanding on this initiative, the** Ministry of Labour and Employment** launched the e-Shram–One-Stop-Solution on October 21, 2024, aligning with the budgetary vision of integrating multiple welfare schemes into a single digital platform.
 
• The e-Shram–One-Stop-Solution integrates 13 central government schemes, allowing unorganised workers to access benefits through a unified platform.
 
• These schemes include Pradhan Mantri Street Vendors Atmanirbhar Nidhi (PM-SVANidhi), Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY), Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY), National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS), Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G), and Ayushman Bharat, among others.
 
• The integration allows registered workers to track the benefits availed through the portal, streamlining access to social security provisions.
 
• To enhance accessibility, the e-Shram portal introduced multilingual functionality on January 7, incorporating the Bhashini platform to support 22 Indian languages. This initiative aims to make the portal more inclusive, enabling workers from diverse linguistic backgrounds to engage with the platform seamlessly.
 
 Bhashini platform__

 
 
• Introduced to provide multilingual support, enhancing accessibility for workers from diverse linguistic backgrounds.

questions.question: Which Indian state has become the first to establish a commission dedicated to the rights and welfare of senior citizens?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Kerala has become the first Indian state to pass a law creating a Senior Citizens Commission to ensure the rights, welfare, and rehabilitation of the elderly.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Kerala State Senior Citizens Commission Bill was passed on 19 March 2025.**
 
• Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan announced the formation of this first-of-its-kind commission in India.
 
• The commission will focus on rehabilitation, welfare, security, and active societal participation of senior citizens.
 
• It will also address hardships such as neglect, exploitation, and loneliness faced by the elderly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• __**Senior Citizens Commission**__ will issue guidelines and implement policies to support and engage senior citizens in the development of "New Kerala."
 
• This initiative reinforces the objectives of inclusive governance and social justice, promoting dignity and care for all age groups.
 
• The commission is part of Kerala’s broader efforts under the Left Democratic Front (LDF) government to ensure dignified ageing and community integration.

questions.question: What was the name of the ICC Champions Trophy tournament before it was renamed in 2002?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**ICC KnockOut Trophy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Champions Trophy** tournament, organized by the **International Cricket Council (ICC)**, began in **1998** in **Bangladesh** as the **ICC KnockOut Trophy**.
 
• **South Africa** won the inaugural Champions Trophy by defeating the **West Indies** in the final.
 
• Early editions of the Champions Trophy were held in **ICC Associate member nations** to promote the sport in those regions. For example, **Kenya** hosted the tournament in **2000**.
 
• From the **2002 edition**, the tournament was renamed as the **Champions Trophy**, also referred to as the **Mini World Cup**, due to a change in format.
 
• Since the **2009 edition**, only the **top eight ODI teams**, based on ICC rankings at a pre-decided qualification cutoff date, compete in the Champions Trophy.

questions.question: In which month is the Kaliyattam festival celebrated?
questions.solution:

The Kaliyattam festival is primarily dedicated to the **worship of Goddess Kali**.

 
 
• 
 
It is celebrated in the Malayalam month of **Kumbham** (February-March).

The festival is celebrated in **Kavus (sacred groves)** and **Tharavadus (ancestral households)**.

• 
 
The festival is also known by the name **Theyyam**.

questions.question: Which organisation organized the 54th National Safety Week in India?

__
 
• **Organized by the National Safety Council (NSC), a premier non-profit organization dedicated to safety awareness in India.**
 
• **The theme for 2025 was “Safety & Well-being Crucial for Viksit Bharat,”** aligning with India's 2047 development vision.
 
• Activities included safety drills, workshops, training programs, and public awareness campaigns.
 
• Emphasized workplace and public safety measures to reduce accidents and ensure a safe environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Safety Council (NSC)**__

 __
 
• Established in 1966 by the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India.
 
• Aim: To promote safety, health, and environment-related initiatives across industries.
 
• Headquarters: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Labour and Employment**__
 __
 
• Regulates labour laws, workplace safety standards, and industrial relations in India.
 
• Oversees the Employees' State Insurance (ESI) and other worker welfare programs.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog**__
 __
 
• India’s policy think tank, responsible for long-term strategic planning and economic reforms.
 
• Formed in 2015, replacing the Planning Commission.
 
 
 
• **Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS)**__
 
 
• India’s national standards body, ensuring product quality and safety.
 
• Sets standards for industrial, commercial, and consumer goods.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as a judge of the Supreme Court from the Calcutta High Court in March 2025?
questions.solution:

questions.question: Which symbol did the Tamil Nadu government use instead of '₹' in its 2025-26 state budget logo?

• **The Tamil Nadu government replaced the Indian rupee symbol '₹' with the Tamil letter 'ரூ' in its state budget logo.**

 __

• The symbol was designed by Udaya Kumar, an IIT Guwahati professor.
